decision_table.name: Determine_CO_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Colorado state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in CO (office, employees, property)

condition.name: has_economic_nexus
condition.comment: Meets CO economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Colorado filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: Colorado Department of Revenue FYI Income 2 (Apportionment and Allocation) Reference: CO Rev. Stat. § 39-22-109 (Nexus requirements)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Colorado filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 in gross receipts to Colorado customers.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: Colorado Department of Revenue Economic Nexus Guidance
No Colorado nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_CO_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Colorado state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Colorado state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Colorado generally conforms to the Internal Revenue Code with some modifications.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - State-specific addbacks
Subtractions may include: - State income taxes deducted on federal return - Colorado NOL deduction (if different from federal)
Reference: CO Form DR 0112 Instructions (Schedule B - Modifications) Reference: CO Rev. Stat. § 39-22-104 (Computation of Colorado taxable income)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_CO_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Colorado state corporate income tax. Applies Colorado flat rate (4.55%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Colorado state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to Colorado: × [Apportionment % - single-sales factor] 3. State additions: + [Additions from Schedule B] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions from Schedule B] 5. Colorado taxable income: = [Result] 6. Colorado tax rate: × 4.55% 7. Colorado income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. Colorado credits: - [Credits] 9. Colorado tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: CO Form DR 0112 Instructions Reference: CO Rev. Stat. § 39-22-104 (Tax rate: 4.55%) Reference: Colorado Department of Revenue Publication FYI Income 2 (Apportionment)
No Colorado nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Colorado taxable income - no tax liability. Colorado NOL rules may apply (not implemented in basic version).
